After that, I want to find flights from New York to London on the date of 'next friday' using the 'flights.search' function. Finally, I want to know the distance in miles from London to Paris using the 'geodistance.find' function again."

origin.description: The originating city for the distance calculation.

unit.description: The unit of measure for the distance calculation.
